bca_jr_locate_job_colonies = {
    optimize_memory
    every_owned_colony = {
        limit = {
            check_modifier_value = {
                modifier = job_$JOB$_add
                value > 0
            }
        }
        owner = {
            create_message = {
                type = MESSAGE_BCA_JOB_LOCATE
                days = 1
                localization = MESSAGE_BCA_JOB_LOCATE_DESC
                target = prev
                variable = {
                    type = name
                    localization = PLANET
                    scope = prev
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = {
    optimize_memory
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_agri_drone }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = agri_drone }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_agri_drone value > bca_jr_best_score }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = value:bca_jr_sort_score_agri_drone }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_alien_hunter }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = alien_hunter }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_alien_hunter value > bca_jr_best_score }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = value:bca_jr_sort_score_alien_hunter }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_archivist }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = archivist }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_archivist value > bca_jr_best_score }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = value:bca_jr_sort_score_archivist }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_ark_harvester }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = ark_harvester }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_harvester value > bca_jr_best_score }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_harvester }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_ark_harvester_gestalt }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = ark_harvester_gestalt }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_harvester_gestalt value > bca_jr_best_score }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_harvester_gestalt }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_ark_waystation_trader }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = ark_waystation_trader }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_waystation_trader value > bca_jr_best_score }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_waystation_trader }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_ark_waystation_trader_gestalt }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = ark_waystation_trader_gestalt }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_waystation_trader_gestalt value > bca_jr_best_score }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value = value:bca_jr_sort_score_ark_waystation_trader_gestalt }
    }

bca_jr_fill_slot_job_stats = {
    optimize_memory
    set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_job_$JOB$
    set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_mapped
    set_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_$JOB$
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_assigned_workforce value = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_capacity_workforce value = bca_jr_total_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_productive_workforce value = bca_jr_total_pop_productive_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_productive_workforce value = bca_jr_total_productive_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_capacity_workforce value = bca_jr_total_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_productive_workforce value = bca_jr_total_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_capacity_limit value = bca_jr_total_pop_capacity_limit_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_total_job_count value = bca_jr_total_job_count_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_free_job_count value = bca_jr_total_free_job_count_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_open_job_count value = bca_jr_total_open_job_count_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_closable_capacity_workforce value = bca_jr_total_closable_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_open_total_capacity value = bca_jr_total_open_job_count_$JOB$ }
    add_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_open_total_capacity value = bca_jr_total_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automation_rate value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_total_job_count value > 0 } }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automation_rate value = bca_jr_total_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ }
        multiply_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automation_rate value = 100 }
        divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automation_rate value = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_total_job_count }
    }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_efficiency_delta value = bca_jr_total_pop_productive_workforce_$JOB$ }
    subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_efficiency_delta value = bca_jr_total_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_efficiency_delta value = bca_jr_total_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$ }
    subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_efficiency_delta value = bca_jr_total_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ }
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_total_efficiency_delta value = bca_jr_total_productive_workforce_$JOB$ }
    subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_total_efficiency_delta value = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_open_total_capacity }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_energy }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_energy value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_energy }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_minerals }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_minerals value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_minerals }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_food }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_food value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_food }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_alloys }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_alloys value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_alloys }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_consumer_goods }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_consumer_goods value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_consumer_goods }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_trade }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_trade value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_trade }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_unity }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_unity value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_unity }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_physics_research }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_physics_research value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_physics_research }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_society_research }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_society_research value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_society_research }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_engineering_research }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_engineering_research value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_engineering_research }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_rare_crystals }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_rare_crystals value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_rare_crystals }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_volatile_motes }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_volatile_motes value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_volatile_motes }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { is_variable_set = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_exotic_gases }
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_output_exotic_gases value = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_exotic_gases }
    }

bca_jr_fill_current_slot = {
    optimize_memory
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_agri_drone }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = agri_drone }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_agri_drone value = bca_jr_best_score }

            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_turtle_miner_gestalt value = bca_jr_best_score }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_slot_job_stats = { SLOT_NAME = $SLOT_NAME$ JOB = turtle_miner_gestalt }
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_mapped_wrangler }
            bca_jr_job_matches_selected_filters = { JOB = wrangler }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_jr_sort_score_wrangler value = bca_jr_best_score }
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = $SLOT_NUM$ }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_slot_job_stats = { SLOT_NAME = $SLOT_NAME$ JOB = wrangler }
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    }
    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_assigned_workforce VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_assigned_workforce }
    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_capacity_workforce VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_capacity_workforce }
    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_productive_workforce VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_productive_workforce }

    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_capacity_workforce VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_capacity_workforce }
    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_productive_workforce VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_automated_productive_workforce }
    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_capacity_limit VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_pop_capacity_limit }
    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_total_job_count VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_total_job_count }
    bca_jr_prepare_display_number = { OUT = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_free_job_count VALUE = bca_jr_slot_$SLOT_NAME$_free_job_count }

bca_jr_refresh_slot_data = {
    optimize_memory
    set_variable = { which = bca_jr_fill_idx value = 1 }
    bca_jr_find_best_for_slot = yes

        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_best_score value > 0 }
        }
        bca_jr_fill_current_slot = { SLOT_NAME = s1 SLOT_NUM = 1 }
